purpose: Continuously convert observed customer/user evidence into roadmap decisions without letting anecdotes bypass product, architecture, security or release gates.
principles: Every meaningful user case study should record the user goal, friction, environment, frequency, severity, workaround and measurable outcome.
Roadmap priority is evidence-weighted: repeated or high-severity friction outranks speculative feature breadth.
Operational pain is product evidence too: installation, upgrades, backup/restore, certificates, incidents, observability and cost belong in roadmap discovery.
Prefer reversible integrations and first-party standards before provider-specific lock-in.
Free tiers are accelerators, not hard availability dependencies; every external service must have an exit path or self-hosted fallback where practical.
Accepted user evidence may reprioritize planned work, but must not silently change domain, security, data-durability or release invariants.

evidence_template.persona_or_context: who/where, without storing unnecessary personal data
evidence_template.job_to_be_done: what the user is trying to accomplish
evidence_template.observed_friction: what failed, confused, slowed or cost the user
evidence_template.metric: how to know the change helped

current_operational_case_studies.job_to_be_done: Run real desktop/mobile browser smoke from the governed development environment without Docker expertise.
current_operational_case_studies.observed_friction: Browser dependencies and browser binaries required manual container-level diagnosis and mutation.
current_operational_case_studies.candidate_change: Bake Chromium OS runtime dependencies into the canonical verify/dev image and keep browser binaries in the persistent node_modules volume.
current_operational_case_studies.metric: A clean rebuild followed by the browser smoke requires no manual apt install or PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH override.

current_operational_case_studies.job_to_be_done: Deploy SongChart to a small production host with HTTPS, durable data, backups and a bounded operator surface.
current_operational_case_studies.observed_friction: A non-Docker specialist needs clear defaults and should not be forced to choose a control panel or certificate workflow before first deploy.
current_operational_case_studies.candidate_change: Keep Docker Compose + SongChart CLI + Caddy as the first-release control plane; add guided doctor/install/status, automatic TLS verification and documented optional integrations.
current_operational_case_studies.metric: Fresh-host installation reaches healthy HTTPS production and verified backup/restore using documented commands without manual web-server configuration.

roadmap_tracks.title: Production operations UX + automatic TLS + low-cost service baseline
deliverables: Caddy automatic HTTPS readiness and certificate-renewal smoke
decision record for direct Docker deployment versus optional control panels
optional Cloudflare-compatible DNS/proxy profile without making Cloudflare mandatory
container registry publishing decision and retention/budget guardrails
uptime/error/backup notification integration points with no single-provider dependency

roadmap_tracks.title: Customer evidence loop
deliverables: Capture support incidents and deployment friction as structured case studies
Review evidence at each stage boundary
Promote repeated friction into roadmap items with a measurable acceptance condition
Retire roadmap items when evidence shows low value, excessive lock-in or maintenance cost
